info.title: Onix.Vault API
info.description:
Auditable vaults for real-world assets. Create a vault from items a custodian holds (custody derived per vault, the creator paid on chain), trade its token on a Meteora curve and, after graduation, on the pool; play for the items (USDC stays in the vault; a burned token shrinks supply); integrate a gacha through reservations. Every state change is anchored to a public transaction: payments are read from the chain before anything leaves custody. The server never holds a user's key and never signs a user's transaction. `x-api-key` is optional: it identifies an integrator for limits; it unlocks nothing.

**1.4.0 (4 Oct 2026, security review):** every route that moves value answers `503` while the operator has paused the server or that vault (`GET /v1/health` → `paused`); every route that signs, settles or reads the chain on demand is rate-fenced per address (`429`); an unexpected error answers a generic `500` with a `ref` (never RPC or database text); addresses must be base58 public keys and signatures base58 text (`400`); `slippageBps` is an integer from 1 to 500; a reservation or a play is reached only through its own vault; an `Idempotency-Key` replays only for the same vault and integrator (`409` otherwise); an admission shows its value only once admitted, read from the chain. See `docs/security-review.md`.

post.summary: Reserve an item for a draw; returns the payment transaction to sign
post.description: Reserve only when your player has already paid you. The exit price is frozen for the reservation window. The response carries `paymentTransaction` (base64, unsigned, single signer = `integrator`, memo = reservation id): sign it, send it, then settle. Honours `Idempotency-Key`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: replays the same reservation for the same vault and integrator; a key already used by another integrator or vault answers 409

integrator.description: the wallet that will pay — a base58 Solana address

winner.description: the wallet that receives the item — a base58 Solana address

post.summary: Prove the payment landed; the vault delivers
post.description: The vault reads the transaction from the chain and checks: finalized; credits the vault's USDC account with at least the frozen price; memo equals the reservation id. Only then it builds the delivery to `winner`, asserts it has a single unsigned signer (the vault), SIMULATES it, signs, persists the signed transaction and broadcasts. A payment signature settles one reservation, ever. `paymentSignature` must be base58 text (400 otherwise, before the chain is asked). A reservation of another vault answers 404.

402.description: payment does not cover the reservation

409.description: not found / not finalized yet / already used — retry later

410.description: reservation expired; refunds are manual in v1

503.description: paid, but the delivery failed (it is simulated before it is signed; a delivery that would fail on chain is never broadcast). The reservation is `delivery_failed`, keeps the payment, and the operator re-runs the delivery by hand (`scripts/retry-delivery.js`); poll `GET …/reservations/{id}` for `deliverySignature`.

post.summary: The player paid: the signature is recorded (UNIQUE). A sweep waits for finality, reads the payment from the transaction itself, draws, holds the item and delivers from custody.

post.description: `signature` must be base58 text (400 otherwise). A play of another vault answers 404.

get.summary: The proof: status, commit, server seed (once done), client seed, nonce, digest, index, snapshot (mints sorted), payment and delivery signatures

post.summary: Quote a buy (USDC → token) or sell (token → USDC) on the live pool
post.description: Meteora DBC quote on the current pool state. 409 until the token launches. One door for the token's whole life: while the curve is live the quote is Meteora DBC's (buys fill up to the graduation threshold and return the rest: amountInUsed, amountInLeft, partial); once migrated the same route trades on the graduated DAMM v2 pool (quote.venue = 'pool', priceImpactPct). The server never signs; the transaction is simulated first (402 with the two numbers when the wallet lacks funds).

amount.description: USDC for buy, tokens for sell

slippageBps.description: how far the price may move before the transaction fails; 1–500 bps

post.summary: Build the swap for the user's wallet to sign — unsigned, single signer = owner, nothing pre-signed
post.description: Returns the base64 transaction and the base58 message Phantom's signAndSendTransaction takes. The server never signs trades. One door for the token's whole life: while the curve is live the quote is Meteora DBC's (buys fill up to the graduation threshold and return the rest: amountInUsed, amountInLeft, partial); once migrated the same route trades on the graduated DAMM v2 pool (quote.venue = 'pool', priceImpactPct). The server never signs; the transaction is simulated first (402 with the two numbers when the wallet lacks funds).

slippageBps.description: how far the price may move before the transaction fails; 1–500 bps

get.summary: USDC and vault token held by a wallet (what the panel shows as balance and Max)
What in a wallet passes THIS vault's rules (custodian, category, minimum value); the rest with the reason

post.summary: Build the transfer of an eligible item from the owner to the vault — unsigned, single signer = owner
post.description: Only an item the owner holds that passes the vault's rules can be built (404 / 422 otherwise). The sender is owed tokens worth value × realisable × 80%, bought on the curve BY THE VAULT once the item is verified on chain and the vault has the USDC (the sweep builds, signs and broadcasts; the admission then carries tokensSignature, tokensAmount, unlockAt). With less USDC than owed it waits as tokens: waiting, with the two numbers in tokensNote.

post.summary: Record a sent admission (the signature of the transfer); verified against the chain within a minute
post.description: `mint` and `owner` must be base58 addresses and `signature` base58 text. The admission is admitted only when custody holds the item and the named transfer was signed by the creator; its value is then read from the item (the one sent is never shown); a transfer signed by anyone else is rejected; nothing after an hour expires.

get.summary: Every admission with its signature, status (pending | admitted) and what is owed
get.description: Lists pending and admitted admissions; `valueUsd` is null until admitted.

get.summary: Trading fees claimed into the treasury (curve partner fee split 2/3 treasury · 1/3 Onix in the same tx; pool LP fee 100% treasury)

200.description: claims[]: curveUsd, poolUsd, onixUsd, treasuryUsd, status, signature, at

get.summary: Items the treasury bought (the restock bot, under the vault's rules)

200.description: purchases[]: mint, name, priceUsd, insuredUsd, venue, status, signature, at

Paused.description: paused for maintenance — nothing is lost; try again later

TooMany.description: rate limit for this address on this kind of request; try again later

paused.description: The emergency stop: while `global` is true, or the vault is listed, every route that moves value answers 503. Nothing is lost; payments already made are processed when it lifts.

vaults.description: vault ids or wallets paused one by one

ref.description: only on 500: a reference the operator finds in the server log (the error text itself never leaves the server)
